# test-op

> Apply a [JSON Patch][json-patch] ([RFC 6902][rfc-6902]) `test` operation.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var testOp = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-patch/ops/test-op' );
```

#### testOp( document, path, value )

Tests whether the value at a path deeply equals an expected value. Returns `true` or `false`.

```javascript
var doc = { 'foo': 'bar' };
var bool = testOp( doc, '/foo', 'bar' );
// returns true
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->
